architectures.name: Metadata database plus object store
architectures.summary: API servers write metadata to a database and content to object storage; reads go through a CDN.
architectures.bestWhen: Pastes vary in size and read traffic is global.

architectures.name: Single key-value store
architectures.summary: Small pastes live directly in a key-value store keyed by paste code with a TTL.
architectures.bestWhen: Pastes are small and operational simplicity matters.
